name: Quiet Web Ring
tagline: A ring for the un-clean web.
manifesto: Personal sites. Slow sites. Weird sites. Sites that have a soul. Sites that don't look like every SaaS in 2026. Make one, link to the ring, the ring links to others like you.
join_via: Open a pull request adding your entry to sites[] in this file. See https://sophieren.com/quiet-ring/#join
criteria: Made by a human (vibes-coded with AI is fine — taste should still be yours).
Doesn't look like every other site.
Real working URL with non-trivial content.
No crypto pumps, no MLM, no engagement-bait.
